answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 12674 Country: Canada Title: When applying ?itr, what part of one?s body is it Sunnah to apply the ?itr onto? Question: When applying ?itr, what part of one?s body is it Sunnah to apply the ?itr onto? Answer ID: 12674 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 769/588=L/1430) I could not find anywhere on which parts the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) used to apply attars. However, it is mentioned that he used to apply it on head and beard. Hadhrat Salmah bin Akwa? ( رضی اللہ عنہ ) says that the Prophet would take musk in hand and apply it on head and beard. (Kanzul Ummal) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
